:::{#exm-smooth-function}
#### A smooth function and one that is not

$f(x) = x^3$ is smooth on $\reals$:
its derivatives are $f'(x) = 3x^2$, $f''(x) = 6x$, $f'''(x) = 6$, and $0$ from then on (@thm-deriv-polynomial),
and each of them is differentiable at every $x$.

$g(x) = x \abs{x}$ is not smooth on any open interval containing $0$.
Its derivative is $g'(x) = 2 \abs{x}$ at every $x$,
and $2 \abs{x}$ is not differentiable at $0$,
so $g''(0)$ does not exist.

:::
